items.brief: Aave Labs launches savings app as balances top $63 million
items.why: Shows consumer-facing savings app using stablecoin deposits across networks.

items.brief: Japan's SBI, SMFG launch Solana joint venture for stablecoin, tokenization
items.why: Entity targets stablecoin payments and real-world asset tokenization.

items.brief: HKMA launches digital asset platform for tokenized debt securities
items.why: Ten banks are first direct participants on HKMA's tokenized debt platform.

items.brief: BlackRock launches HKD tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong
items.why: Adds a fourth currency to BlackRock's tokenized MMF lineup after USD, EUR and GBP funds.

items.brief: Krak plans 2027 US credit cards with bitcoin cashback, one USDC-secured
items.why: Card uses USDC as collateral, linking stablecoins to consumer credit.

items.brief: Fed Governor Waller warns of 'zombie chains' as tokenization grows
items.why: Flags governance risk of tokenized assets stranded on failed blockchains.

items.brief: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
items.why: Assesses shared ledger for central bank money, commercial money and securities.

items.brief: JPMorgan, HSBC, StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
items.why: Tests trading gold fractions and using metal as collateral without moving it.

items.brief: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
items.why: Shows pushback against tokenized equity rollout from competitors and issuers.

items.brief: OKX and ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
items.why: Shows tokenized equity trading expanding despite pushback from 67 objecting companies.
